title: beyondheights
description: Expand the upper and lower limits of world height without loading terrain.
body:
The upper and lower limits of world elevation have been expanded without loading terrain.

Default settings: Both the Main World and End are -2032~2031, the Nether is 0~2031, and the cloud is 1024.

You can modify the height data via the current instance directory /config/beyondheights/beyondheights.properties file.



If the default value (-2032~2032) remains after modifying the configuration file, it means the data has been entered incorrectly.

If the mod is completely ineffective, it means you added other terrain mods that would otherwise modify the height limit.


对世界高度上下限进行了拓展，不加载地形。

默认设定：主世界和末地都是 -2032~2031，下界是 0~2031，云层 1024。

可通过 当前实例目录/config/beyondheights/beyondheights.properties 文件修改高度数据。



如果修改配置文件后仍然是默认值（-2032~2032），说明填错了数据。

如果模组完全不生效，说明加了其他本身就会修改限高的地形模组 。


MC百科：https://www.mcmod.cn/class/26521.html
